description: The step-by-step set-up of a store on LetsBot (Salla, Zid, Shopify, …): 1 connect the WhatsApp number, 2 store notifications (order status, verification code, welcome, review), 3 abandoned-cart reminders, 4 cash-on-delivery confirmation, 5 AI replies. Use it when the merchant asks to set up his store/account or "what is left"; then walk him through the first unfinished step.
name: get_store_setup_checklist
